title: Moesha
description:
S3 E7 — Use Me Once Shame On You, Use Me Twice I’ll Kill You
Mo tells her friends at the Den that Hayley’s dad is an important record executive.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E8 — Keepin’ It Real
Mo is attracted to a classmate she is working with on a project.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E9 — Halloween Part 1 – Kim’s Revenge
Mo, Kim and Niecy decide to dress as “The Women of Batman” for Halloween.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E10 — Rhythm Dues
Mo encourages CPQ to submit their latest song to the local radio station for their “play it or stuff it” segment. When the song is played, it is well received.  Q has written lyrics over a Morris Day song, and Morris shows up at “The Hole” where he plays.

S3 E15 — Teach Me Tonight, Part I
When Mary and Lester's school teacher friend Mitchell meets Sandra, he sets out to win her pampered heart, no matter how many gifts or expensive dates it takes.

S3 E16 — Teach Me Tonight, Part II
After a whirlwind courtship, Sandra accepts Mitchell's wedding proposal, making a commitment to trade in her glamorous life for what she not-so-long-ago considered a boring existence.

S3 E17 — Rapture
When Pearl finds out that Calvin is failing his history class, Mary, Rose and Lester each take turns as tutor-in-residence.

S3 E18 — Sweet Sixteen
Though Brenda's but a week away from her sixteenth birthday, a milestone marking newfound dating freedom, Mary refuses to bend the rules and allow her to accept Calvin's invitation to the party of the year.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E22 — Car Trouble
Eddie finds a gangster's hidden cash hidden inside Malcolm's new car.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E23 — Kansas City Split
When Malcolm falls for a spiritual guru and Eddie gets a new job offer, they agree to sell the business and move on.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E1
An aspiring radio sports announcer, Malcolm, and his talkative, would-be tow truck driver roommate, Eddie, attend a get-rich-quick seminar in hopes of winning a much-needed TV.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E2 — Eddie By Moonlight
Eddie needs another job to get his prized tow truck repaired.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E3 — On The Radio
A chance to fill in on an all-night music show has Malcolm exhausted.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E14 — Fred & Carol & Fred & Donna
When Fred invites his fiancée Donna and a door-to-door saleslady to dinner on the same evening, Lamont is convulsed by his father's attempts to keep the women apart.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E15 — A Guest In The Yard
Fred and Lamont find a bum in their yard. The Sanfords are jumping to his every whim for fear he'll make good his threat. The uninvited guest claims Fred pushed him -- creating untold injuries -- and he's threatened to sue them for everything they own.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E16 — The Big Party
Faced with more bills than they can pay, Fred and Lamont decide to give a neighborhood party -- and charge admission. Everything goes well until two gangsters show up and make the Sanfords 'an offer they can't refuse.'.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E17 — Lamont Goes African
Fred thinks Lamont's fascinations with Africa are ludicrous, until he meets Olaiya, a Nigerian woman. Lamont adopts African dress and customs to impress Olaiya, but Lamont's lack of respect for his father interferes with his goal.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E12 — Florence Gets Lucky
George must make a painful admission when he discovers he needs Florence far more than he could ever expect.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E13 — George Needs Help
When George stubbornly refuses to hire some badly needed help for his store, Louise and Florence combine forces to make him change his mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.
